title: metadata-protocol: a first draft pinned `If-None-Match: *` on a sealed package-shipped item gets the create remedy ("name is taken"): `sealedWrite` reads a `null` parent as a create, the spec as "no row of this lifecycle"
body:
Filing gate **① a defect on a published face, measured.** `reach:` the public HTTP door `PUT /api/v1/meta/:type/:name?mode=draft`, measured once on the published `@objectstack/cli` `18.0.0-next.0` (`objectstack dev --fresh`).

Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 1 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#5560, `session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`). The maintainer asked for it in that session, verbatim: 「补开」. It was found by the os-dev of objectstack-ai/objectui#11773 (report `6161169286`, finding 2) while that card wired Studio's first draft save to `If-None-Match: *`.
- **Reader (who acts):** central triage routes it. The fix lands in `packages/metadata-protocol` (`saveMetaItem`), with `packages/spec`'s `MetadataConflictErrorSchema` / `SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion` as the contract it must agree with.
- **Dedupe:** MCP `search_issues` on this repo, closed included, for `If-None-Match first draft sealed package-shipped item NOT_OVERRIDABLE name taken first-write pin parentVersion null`: 13 hits, none this question.
  - Related history: #22114 (closed), where the draft read gained its version token, and #22128 (closed), a package-less draft save refused 409.
  - Open neighbours on the package axis: #23291 and #23297. Neither covers the sealed-item refusal's remedy.
- ⛔ Not a claim. For triage to grade.

## Measured (published `18.0.0-next.0`)

The item is `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/occ_ticket?mode=draft`, an object shipped by the app's code package (`layers`: `editable: false`, `lock: full`).

| request | answer |
|:--|:--|
| unpinned | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "… Edit the source artifact and redeploy." |
| `If-None-Match: *` (the first-write pin; no draft row exists) | 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` "… so its name is taken. To author your own object, choose a name no package or built-in holds …" |

Both requests are refused, and that is right. But the pinned request is told to pick another name, which is the remedy for a create, while it is a first draft of an existing item. A client or AI author following that remedy creates a second object instead of editing the source artifact.

A second, smaller symptom of the same reading: a first-write pin refused over an existing draft answers "… has been modified since you loaded it. Expected parent null but current is …". The client loaded no draft. It asserted that none existed.

## Why: two readings of a `null` parent

- **The spec** (`SaveMetaItemRequestSchema.parentVersion` describe in `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`): "a present `null` asserts 'no current row of this lifecycle' — the first-write pin". `MetadataConflictErrorSchema.currentVersion` is "`null` when no row of the target lifecycle exists. Send it as `If-Match` … (or `If-None-Match: *` when it is `null`)". So a first draft over a published item is a legitimate `null` pin.
- **The implementation** (`saveMetaItem` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`, the `[#22591]` comment): "a present `null` parent is the first-write pin … the caller holds no row under the name and is writing one of its own, a create". It sets `sealedWrite = request.parentVersion === null ? 'create' : 'save'`, and the sealed-item refusal picks its remedy from that.

For a draft save, the two disagree: no row of the draft lifecycle does not mean no row under the name.

## Ask

Make the sealed-item refusal's create-or-edit judgement read whether a row exists under the name, rather than read the pin. Re-word the refused first-write pin's 409 so it says a row already exists. Pin both on the REST door: a pinned first draft over a published sealed item, and a pinned create of a taken name.

## Reach today

- objectui's Studio gates sealed items read-only, so no first-party editor reaches the remedy today.
- Any REST client that pins first drafts as the spec describes does reach it, and from objectstack-ai/objectui#11773 on that includes objectui's metadata client (`MetadataClientSaveOptions.ifNoneMatch`).
